transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello! I'm Dora, a clinical conversational agent. I conducted your follow-up check after your cataract surgery. Do you have any questions about your surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Hi Dora! Yes, I do have a few questions. First, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can start with light exercise, including gardening, about 1 week after surgery. However, it's essential to avoid strenuous activity, lifting heavy objects, or bending for a month. Also, be careful not to get water in your eyes, especially in the first month. You can go back to gardening, but with caution, about 1 week after surgery.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Got it, thanks for letting me know. My next question is, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You should have started using preservative-free eye drops four times a day to help with dryness. If you've already got some, you can start using them right away. If you're running out, you can get some more from your GP.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Okay, good to know. I'm also feeling very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal after the surgery?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It's normal to feel sensitive to light for a bit after surgery, especially when it's bright. Wearing sunglasses can help. If it's severe or you're experiencing significant pain, we may need to take a closer look.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thanks, I'll try wearing sunglasses more often. One more thing, should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It's common for vision to not be completely clear in the first week after surgery, but it should improve quickly. If your vision is still blurry, or getting significantly worse, we may need to check it to make sure it's okay.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Alright, thank you for all the information, Dora. I don't have any more questions at the moment.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It was my pleasure to help. I'm glad I could answer your questions. Now, to confirm, all your questions about your cataract surgery recovery have been answered, right?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, all my questions have been answered. Thank you!
